# Getting help

- **How do I ...?** Start with the README: Install, Configure and Customize
  cover every param and hook. If it does not answer the question, ask in
  [Discussions](https://github.com/haydenk/mimeo/discussions).
- **Something renders wrong.** Open a
  [bug report](https://github.com/haydenk/mimeo/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
  Include your Hugo version and a minimal page or config that shows it.
- **An idea.** Open a
  [feature request](https://github.com/haydenk/mimeo/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml),
  or a discussion if it is still vague.
- **A security problem.** See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md); please do not file
  it as a public issue.

The live demo at <https://haydenk.github.io/mimeo/> is built from
`exampleSite/` in this repository, so it always matches the latest release.
